fu.clip_feature: cached native30 temporal max/spatial max per window then equal-window mean; concatenate t,s

model.adapter: LayerNorm -> Linear -> GELU -> Dropout -> zero-init Linear -> residual add
model.j1_initialization: new adapter seed0; copy selected J0 heads; no DSTE/ADL loaded or optimized

training.loss: sum of SAFER and FU CE; each has train-only inverse-sqrt class counts normalized by mean; absent count clamped1
training.sampling: one pass shuffled SAFER per epoch; each step one FU32 batch, cycle independent shuffled train-only FU indices without dropping samples
training.shuffle: CPU generator seed+2*epoch for SAFER and seed+2*epoch+1 for FU; epoch starts at1
training.selection: mean(SAFER validation macroF1,FU designated validation F1), then FU AP, then SAFER conditional AP; exact ties earliest epoch

development.claim: development validation OOF, not nested performance

locked_safer.after: all five J0/J1 checkpoint pairs locked
locked_safer.ensemble: mean raw logits over five folds before softmax/argmax

nested.outer_access: only after fold J0/J1 selection locked
nested.claim: post-design nested control, not pristine external test

final.epochs: integer median of five new nested inner-selected epochs separately for J0 and J1, not historical constant
final.evaluation: training diagnostic only, never generalization evidence
final.zero_median_j1: retain copied J0 with zero correction

newly_specified_not_recovered: V1/V2 feature lineage and FU pooling
AdamW type/betas/eps/gamma and train-only CE weights
development uses same 30/20 schedule as documented nested CLI
combined selection key and RNG sequence
